title: Tryouts and Detention
author: Ivo Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Montrose, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
